content:
Sam: morning — quick async standup for the rollout. what I did: kicked off canary for ff/enable-new-routing at 3% (region-us-west), ran smoke tests, validated tracing hooks.
Priya: saw the canary come up, pods stable. added temporary logging for the new routing code path.
Marcus: ran perf check vs baseline, 99th p95 latency +12ms on small samples. nothing alarming but worth watching for traffic spikes.
Elaine: FYI product asked for a failsafe threshold at 5% errors, do we have an automated cutover?
Sam: we have auto-fallback configured: if 5% errors or 15% increase in 99th latency over 10m -> rollback. currently metrics below thresholds.
Priya: rolling health summary from deploy-bot:
```
deploy-bot: rollout-status ff/enable-new-routing
canary: 3% (us-west)
errors: 0.4% (baseline 0.3%)
latency_p95: +11ms over baseline
no crashloops
```
Marcus: code review ping @Priya — small nits in routing_fallback.go, also add a comment about the timeout.
Priya: ack, I'll push a patch in a minute.
Elaine: blockers: I need confirmation that dedicated customers won't be routed to canary models. Product flagged a compliance question.
Sam: dedicated capacity excluded by route rules — double-checked with smart-routing policy. @Marcus can you cross-verify the policy entry?
Marcus: confirmed. policy id route:dedicated-exempt present and references cluster_label:dedi=true.
Priya: pushed fix and re-ran unit tests. patch link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/p/routing/+/2345 :minor formatting + comment.
Sam: thanks. next steps: watch metrics for another 30m, if stable bump to 10% and notify SRE for broader Canary.
Elaine: I'll update product and ops playbook with the failover thresholds and link to the config.
deploy-bot: alert: simulated traffic sweep scheduled in 10m — remember to mute low-priority pager for that window if you're oncall. :robot_face:
Sam: quick question for release team — anyone oncall in the 12:30-1:30 PST window?
Marcus: I'll be covering 12:30-1:00 then handing to @Priya.
Priya: correct, taking 1:00-1:30.
Sam: perfect. if anything pops, post here and we can escalate to eng-sre.
Elaine: no blockers from my side. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Marcus: one more note — created a Grafana panel under canary -> enable-new-routing, added alert for p95>200ms for 5m.
Sam: solid. I'll open a short post-rollout report once we hit 10% and again at 100%.
Priya: closing loop on code review, merged.
Sam: end of thread — keeping this thread as the async log for the next steps.
